name: matrix-arcade16
note: THE ARCADE OCCUPANCY THROUGHPUT COST, attributed by the change's OWN --noplay hatch. Twelve arms: {baseline, growth} x seedbase {0,16,32} x {as-built, noplay}. as-built = occupancy ON (the shipped game, a crab stands at a machine for playT); noplay = the SAME TREE with occupancy disarmed (--noplay: the arcade still sells a token, still takes the money, still zeroes boredom, only the machine-hold goes away). So the delta is attributable to occupancy, not to whatever else moved on main. Three 16-town blocks per the plan doc (kd-xScTUuhKv7): 16 is the honest minimum, 8 is a coin. BASELINE (buy nothing) is the instrument-validation control: with no arcade, --noplay is a pure no-op, so baseline-asbuilt and baseline-noplay MUST return identical survived/lifetime and arcade.games==0 - if they diverge the flag has a side effect and the growth delta below cannot be trusted. GROWTH buys chef,table,arcade (chosen by the buy-list probe: the list that built AND used an arcade in the most towns). The signed number to read: growth-noplay survived - growth-asbuilt survived, over the towns arcade.playedIn says actually had a working arcade. Expected: small NEGATIVE on growth (occupancy costs throughput). Name it; do not tune it away. 30 days, batch.mjs --json receipts.
